coverageUnits.scope: 客户/员工身份、workspace 与组织访问
auth domains、签名、凭据、审计与脱敏

A4 deployment evidence → A5 acceptance-admission boundary observation

notApplicableReasons.reason: A0 subject claim/binding/risk rows carry no deadline or expiry semantics; A4 explicitly leaves SLO/timeout/RPO/RTO unapproved and its backup/capability gates are not request deadlines.
A4 BACKUP_DEPENDENCY and CAPABILITY inputs are exact-set typed inputs; duplicates are INVALID and there is no event sequence or arrival-order semantic.
The A4 calculator has no runtime caller identity, role or tenant; CALLER_CONTROL_FORBIDDEN is input integrity, not permission. A3 auth domains cover API surfaces only.
